a2_control_note: the predeclared A2 family map names only the 29 certified axes, so the matched uncertified arm is scored against its certified partner's adjacency vector -- a name-transplant control, added after the map was found not to cover the control arm and recorded as an addition. A1's control arm uses each control axis's OWN adjacency, which is §2.5 verbatim, and A1 is the primary.
